---
title: "Advanced Topics in Machine Learning 2019-1"
---

This course explores advanced topics in machine learning and artificial intelligence, including clustering algorithms, regression methods, automated machine learning, generative adversarial networks, reinforcement learning, explainable AI, and modern deep learning architectures.     
ITM – Institución Universitaria @2019
